name: Statement Basis 3 Code
definition: Specifies the basis on which the statement is prepared expressed as a code.

EOSP.name: End Of Settlement Positions
EOSP.definition: Mark-to-Market report sent after settlement. All transactions which have been initiated.

FUTM.name: Future Mark To Market
FUTM.definition: Mark-to-market report taking into account collateral management actions which are still pending initiation and initiated transactions.
